scripts.build: pnpm run build:bundle && pnpm run build:resources
scripts.preview: pnpm run build && cross-env GENERATORAI_DESKTOP_MODE=standalone electron .
scripts.build:server: pnpm --filter @generatorai/server... build && pnpm --filter @generatorai/server bundle && node scripts/stage-server-runtime.mjs
scripts.prepack:dist: pnpm --filter @generatorai/web build && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:server

scripts.lint: node scripts/uniwind-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/gen-material-filled.mjs --check && eslint src/ app/ --quiet && node scripts/check-design.mjs
